title: VICTORIAN CEDAR CHIFFONIER BAS...
reason: Victorian Australian cedar chiffonier base with figured panels and carved corbels in sound looking condition; useful period furniture (my estimate A$100-250).
findings: Victorian chiffonier base in cedar (as catalogued; the reddish colour, flame-figured door panels and wide single-board sides are consistent with Australian red cedar): moulded top with two small screw holes at the back showing a superstructure or back has been removed, long ogee-moulded frieze drawer, pair of arched-panel doors with applied shaped mouldings, carved C-scroll and acanthus corbels at the front corners, glass door knob with brass lock fittings, plinth base. The interior has a fixed shelf above the base (photo 4); the drawer has a plain timber bottom (photo 5). No maker's label, stencil or stamp seen in any of the five photos.
condition: Polished surface with scuffs and fading; one corbel shows a crack or gap along its edge (photo 3); lock working order unknown; top shows screw holes from the removed back.
rescore_note: Victorian cedar (probably) chiffonier base with figured doors and carved corbels, but the back is removed, one corbel is cracked and brown furniture is soft; Lawsons estimated a cedar two-drawer chiffonier with its back at $250 to 350 (invaluable.com, sale 14 Jul 2026, seen 19/10/2026); my estimate $120 to 250.
